APPLICATIONS.NO_POSTING: No posting saved for this application.
APPLICATIONS.NO_BRIEF: No brief saved for this application.
APPLICATIONS.NO_GAPS: No gaps found against the posting.
APPLICATIONS.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: Deletes the "{label}" folder with its posting, resume, cover letter and gaps file. This can't be undone.

DIALOG.TITLE: New job application
DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: Paste a posting or an application question.
DIALOG.TEXT_PLACEHOLDER: Job posting or application question, with optional notes
DIALOG.QUEUED: Job application queued; it starts when a run finishes

HELP.LABEL: Help
HELP.TITLE: Adding a job application
HELP.DESCRIPTION_AFTER: to your bookmarks bar, then click it on a job posting to open the new job application form filled in from the page.
HELP.MANUAL: Or paste a posting or an application question yourself.

RESUME.PDF_FAILED: Saved, but the resume PDF could not be regenerated
RESUME.NONE: This application has no editable resume. Applications generated from now on keep one.
RESUME.NEED_TWO: Save a change to start comparing versions.

COVER_LETTER.NONE: This application has no cover letter.
COVER_LETTER.NO_PDF: No cover letter PDF has been generated.
COVER_LETTER.PDF_FAILED: Saved, but the cover letter PDF could not be regenerated. It may exceed one page.

CAREER.RESET_DESCRIPTION: Choose how to replace the saved file.
CAREER.UPLOAD_HINT: Paste text or upload a .txt, .md, .json or .pdf file, such as an existing resume. Claude formats it into this shape using only its facts, and the result replaces the saved file when the run finishes.
CAREER.UPLOAD_PLACEHOLDER: Paste a resume, profile or notes
CAREER.CLEAR_HINT: Keep the required headings and fields with every entry removed.
CAREER.SAMPLE_HINT: A fictional mid-senior full stack developer that shows the expected detail.
CAREER.CONFIRM_REPLACE: This replaces the saved {label} right away.

DEMO.NOTICE: Public demo · Explore a fictional application, resume, cover letter and run history. Saving, importing and live AI runs are disabled.
DEMO.READ_ONLY: This demo is read-only. Self-host Job Hunt to save career files or run Claude.

MATCHES.SUGGEST_FAILED: Failed to start the suggestion run
MATCHES.NO_FILTER_MATCHES: No postings match the filters. Postings captured before Easy Apply was recorded need a new capture.
MATCHES.DESCRIPTION_BEFORE: Open a LinkedIn job search page and click the
MATCHES.DESCRIPTION_AFTER: (drag it to your bookmarks bar). It opens every result, then scores each posting's skills against your career experience.
MATCHES.NO_SKILLS: Your career experience lists no skills, so every posting scores as a gap.
MATCHES.LOAD_FAILED: Failed to load your career experience
